semanticDiffSummary: The specification delta adopts the captured Pro response's own recommendations and three user interview decisions made after capture: DEC-009 queue-saturation fail-stop (Q-002), DEC-010 non-UI classification of the dev-only trigger (Q-003), DEC-011 command and schema edge-case clarifications, an AC-005 clause for blocked_by_prerequisite, a DEC-003 title-grammar alignment to its accepted examples, FEATURE.md synchronization of the optional-name, channel-envelope, and null-window contracts, and interview ledger entries GA-007/Q-002/Q-003.
applicabilityRationale: Every change either implements what the immutable Pro response itself recommended (store-owned shot persistence, persistence-before-channel, queue policy question, permission status shape) or records user decisions and coordinator clarifications inside unaddressed edge cases; no accepted goal, scope boundary, acceptance outcome, or architectural recommendation the response analyzed was altered, so the prior response remains fully applicable to the revised specification without a fresh primary.
